messages:
maya: Quick sync — Enterprise FG2 asked for a "staircase" surge add-on: tiers that unlock additional burst capacity as usage grows during a billing window. Wants predictable per-token cap while avoiding an all-or-nothing reserved commit.

maya: Main asks: 1) soft commit baseline, 2) automatic staircase tiers (e.g., +20% at +X usage), 3) capped effective unit price per-tier, 4) carryover unused burst for 30d.

tom: From sales: customer will only sign if we can guarantee no >2x cost spikes. They like staircase vs pure on-demand because it gives control. Need a clear guardrail for overage billing.

asha: From eng: implementation notes — we can implement staircase as per-route throttles + dynamic routing to reserved pools. Complexity: billing needs per-token attribution across tiers. KV caches and batching may change effective tokens counted.

lisa: Finance: risk here is revenue leakage if carryover + staircase combo lets customers flatten to cheaper effective price. Need per-customer simulation for 6 months before greenlight. Also want explicit grace/fallthrough rules in contract.

cam: Legal: prefer to limit carryover to X% of purchased burst and exclude credits from trial promos. Also need explicit SLA language for burst availability and an opt-out clause for capacity emergencies.

maya: Proposed minimal MVP scope for launch: - single staircase addon SKU - 2 tiers (+25%, +50%) - 30d limited carryover capped at 50% of last-tier capacity - per-route opt-in boolean + analytics in Console.

tom: MVP sounds okay for FG2. Can we add rollout criteria? Sales needs at least 2 pilot customers and 3rd-party cost simulations.

asha: Launch criteria request from eng: 1) end-to-end billing prototype (dev env), 2) integration test for routing fallback, 3) Console UI for per-route opt-in and token breakdown, 4) perf regression <5% p95 latency.

lisa: Finance launch gates: 1) Monte Carlo revenue impact <5% downside in base case, 2) pricing matrix documented, 3) legal-approved T&Cs.

cam: Legal gate: approved contract language + CLM templates + escalation path for capacity incidents.

dev-bot: FYI — created tracker GH issue #6823 for engineering tasks and linked to product spec doc.

maya: Next steps: asha to prototype billing prototype + routing; lisa to run sims; cam draft T&C; tom lock 2 pilots. Sync tomorrow 10:30am. :thumbsup:

tom: ack

asha: will start today, will post quick sketch in #eng-runtime

lisa: starting sims now

cam: drafting standard clause, will share by EOD
